coordination.scope: readiness, exact evidence, owner handoffs, independent review, focused integration; existing integration leases retained

descriptors.scope: versioned public descriptor and supported type/identity contracts; no direct consumer rewrite

runtime_state.scope: admission, verified context, transactions, registry, rules/fences/replay; current metadata/fanout leases retained

forms_interfaces.scope: canonical form/read rendering, lookup, actions, context, browser draft/partial/polling, CSV; one writer on shared files

app_witnesses.role: application author and independent journey owner
app_witnesses.scope: complete pinned source/policies/BDD, before/after comparisons, real generated/browser/durable/provider routes

values_calendar.scope: pure helpers, versioned timezone/calendar data contract and independent reference cases
